item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's teacher asks her to collect a spoonful of soil from the school garden in Jaipur. After looking at it closely, Meena writes down what the soil is most likely to contain. Which of her statements is correct?

options.A: Soil contains only sand and small stones, with nothing living in it.
options.B: Soil contains sand, tiny organisms, worms, and decayed plant and animal matter.
options.C: Soil contains only water that collects when rain falls on the ground.
options.D: Soil contains large unbroken pieces of rock that have not changed at all.
